features.passwordPopup: none - #ansInput is type=text with autocomplete=off, never a password field
features.keyboard: native system keyboard only (text input + single-space IME buffer reset + plain-text mirror)
features.ready: v42: opening Are you ready? speaks brief professional instructions in the single British voice; Yes, I'm ready cancels them cleanly and speaks Three, two, one in sync with the 3-2-1 visual countdown; Word 1 starts only after BOTH the visual ticks and the audio have finished
features.feedback: animated tick, streak breakdown and false-answer correction flow
features.visual: v40: human-crafted architectural studio interface - 10px buttons, 16px cards, 12px tiles, zero 999px bubble pills, zero orbs, discs, rings or neon glows
features.guideStart: Start practising closes the guide, unlocks speech, opens Home and launches Eng.start({})
features.search: Lib.searchIndex caches tokens across Session 7, my words and mistakes
features.ambient: Hardware video wallpaper in Lite and Full; neon canvas sleeps when interactions finish
features.liveWallpaper: bunny-live-wallpaper.mp4 is the 100% default active video on the single #bgLiveVideo hardware overlay (filter:none, translateZ(0), poster frame); it plays behind the Home screen, every tab, the .layer Dictation Player, the Are you ready? sheet and the Results screen
features.githubVideos: CONFIG.repoMedia lists only ./assets/bunny-live-wallpaper.mp4; runtime discovery is cached for fifteen minutes in sdp.gh_assets_v42 and every older gh_assets cache is purged on boot
features.ambilight: v34: #bgLiveAmbilight is permanently inert (display:none, no src, never loaded); #bgLivePhotoAmbilight still supports portrait photos
features.gallery: Lazy zero-bandwidth gallery: no gallery DOM on boot, inactive cards use preload=none data-src videos or lazy poster ; bytes load only on an explicit Preview tap or Apply
features.wallpaper: Hardware video wallpaper in Lite and Full; neon canvas sleeps when interactions finish
features.githubMedia: discoverGitHubMedia reads only the GitHub contents API for assets/ and normalises download_url, origin prefixes, /assets/, ?v= and #t= suffixes to ./assets/<file>
features.readability: #bgContrastScrim adaptive radial scrim, --bg-dim live slider (#sVideoDim) 0-75, 18% default, crisp 0 1px 2px text shadows in dark and light themes
features.photoWallpaper: #bgLivePhoto + #bgLivePhotoAmbilight with 12s auto-cycle for photos and ended-driven cycling for videos
features.crystalGlass: v37: smoked slate rgba(11,15,25,0.72) panels with zero backdrop-filter keep the bunny live wallpaper visible behind the layout
features.playback: src attribute on #bgLiveVideo with the _loadedSrc guard (no redundant load()), muted autoplay, idempotent play guards, 4s stall recovery, stale Service Worker removal and ?v=34 JSON cache busters guarantee playback
features.storage: CONFIG.key is sdp.v41_unified_voice_lifecycle with schema 41 and settingsRev 41; sdp.v40_one_studio_voice, sdp.v39_single_unified_voice and every older profile are read once and migrated on boot
features.highlightedUi: v35: every control is high-impact - iridescent rainbow liquid glass capsules (cyan #38bdf8 to indigo #6366f1 to violet #c084fc to rose #f472b6 to mint #2dd4bf, zero red/coral) for primary actions, smoked iridescent lenses for secondary/ghost/icon/pill buttons, rainbow droplet capsules in every segmented switch and dock tab, solid white #homeTitle with a cyan glow and neon-bordered inputs, slots and answer mirror
features.rainbowLiquidGlass: v37: fully retired - no rainbow stripes, no neon glows, no glowing text shadows
features.springPhysics: v37: GPU-composited transform/opacity spring curves drive press, dock glide and screen/sheet morphs at 60-120fps
features.lowEnd: v37: single hardware video overlay, sleeping canvas, contain:layout style and transform-only transitions keep low-end phones smooth
features.instantResponse: v37: 0.04s press recognition, 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) spring release, 0.22s screen and sheet glide, GPU transform/opacity only, a 60ms debounced DB.save() and a canvas that ignores UI taps
features.typography: v37: Inter + Apple system stack for English, Noto Sans Sinhala / Sinhala Sangam MN / Nirmala UI for Sinhala at line-height 1.72, loaded from a runtime style tag (never a static <link>)
features.creditSpotlight: v37: body.credit-intro lifts CREDITS GOES TO Hansana to the top-centre reading focal point for 2.8s on first paint, then hansanaRevealCycle (8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite) breathes between opacity 1 and 0.12
features.englishDefault: English (lang "en", guideLang "en") remains the default, with an optional Sinhala switch inside the User Guide.
features.humanVoice: v42: one unified British English (en-GB) female neural voice from https://dict.youdao.com/dictvoice?type=1&audio=<text %20.>; zero Google translate_tts requests, zero 403 silence, zero two-voice switching
features.sessionFlow: v42: instructions -> 3-2-1 countdown (visual AND audio) -> Number N, <word> . -> 650ms studio silence -> <word> . -> 5s writing timer -> next word
features.cleanWords: v42: TTS.cleanWordOnly strips bilingual slashes (tyre/tire -> tyre) so only the clean target word or phrase ever reaches the single voice
features.repeatReplay: v42: Pass 1 announces the dictation number and the clean word in one continuous stream, a 650ms studio silence follows on the onended event, then Pass 2 repeats only the clean word through the same single voice before the 5s writing timer
features.noDeviceVoice: v42: window.speechSynthesis.speak() is never called on a live online browser while the master <audio> works (speechSynthesis.cancel() always runs instead); the locked en-GB female device voice is only the emergency fallback after the 1500ms audio watchdog, and the normal offline/headless path
features.voiceLifecycle: v42: Eng.readyGo() speaks 'Three, two, one .' and waits for BOTH the spoken countdown and the visual 3-2-1 ticks before Eng.startWord(0); every TTS.stop()/speakSingle() bumps TTS._seqToken, clears _watchdog/_gapTimer/_lenTimer and detaches the master <audio> handlers
features.testSound: v42: 'Sound check. Number 1, bicycle .' through the one dictation voice, then the UI shows the verified tick
features.numberedWords: v42: 'Number N, <word> .' then the clean '<word> .' after a 650ms studio pause, and a 5 second writing countdown
features.pauseResume: v42: pause speaks 'Session paused .' and freezes every timer; resume speaks 'Welcome back. Continuing dictation number N .' and then restarts the full word
features.finishSummary: v42: 'Dictation complete. Well done. Review all thirty words below .' or the spoken score in type mode
features.tts: v42: the singleVoiceUrl entries are the one en-GB neural endpoint (Youdao dictvoice type=1); silenceBetweenRepeatsMs is 650
features.voice: v42: exactly one voice engine - https://dict.youdao.com/dictvoice?type=1&audio= - every clip is formatted with a trailing ' .' so single words, phrases, numbers, countdowns and instructions are all synthesised by the same unified British English (en-GB) female neural model; there is never a second legacy clip voice
features.fallback: v42: if the master <audio> errors or does not start within 1500ms the engine falls back at once to TTS.speakPinnedSynth() - one locked en-GB female device voice - so the app never hangs in silence
features.dictationNumber: v42: the Dictation Player always shows a high-contrast 'Dictation #N of 30' badge (#plProgText, #plStep, #plStepBadge) and 'Paused - Dictation #N of 30' while the session is paused
